title: Peregrine
description: The fastest animal alive would like its sandwich back. Flap above the city, wait for DIVE!, then stoop on the pigeon that stole your lunch. One button, five districts, a narrator who has seen enough.
controls: Tap, click or Space: flap. Hold: dive (release to pull out). Down/S also dives. P pauses, M mutes, R restarts, Esc returns to the menu.
